# Parity fixtures — provenance

Both JSON files in this directory were generated by running shenron's *actual*
TypeScript source under `bun`, not hand-derived, on 2026-09-19:

- `eval_golden.json` — `bun run gen_eval_golden.ts`, a throwaway script (not
  committed anywhere) that imported
  `%USERPROFILE%\shenron\apps\bot\src\lib\rag-eval.ts` directly and called
  `runCase`, `aggregate`, `aggregateByTag`, `normalizeUrl`, and
  `matchesExpectedUrl` on a small, hand-built set of queries/hits.
- `prose_chunk_golden.json` — `bun run gen_chunk_golden.ts`, a throwaway
  script that imported
  `%USERPROFILE%\shenron\apps\bot\scripts\_rag-chunk.ts`'s `chunkDocument`
  directly and ran it over a small Markdown document with
  `maxChunkChars = 220`, `overlapPct = 0.15`.

`tests/ts_parity_golden.rs` replays the same inputs through this crate's Rust
ports (`aphrody_rag_core::eval` and `aphrody_rag_core::MarkdownChunker`) and
asserts the outputs match these files exactly (floats compared with a tight
epsilon; `sans-tag` in the TS output is renamed `untagged` on the Rust side
per the repository's English-only-identifiers naming contract — the test
remaps the key before comparing, everything else is unchanged).

Regenerating: re-run the same two scripts (recreate them from the snippets
above, they are intentionally not part of this repository) against a
checkout of `shenron` at the commit noted in the surrounding PR, and replace
these two files.
